matthew.15.p1.b1.text: Then some Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,

matthew.15.p1.b2.text: Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders?

matthew.15.p1.b3.text: They do not wash their hands before they eat.

matthew.15.p2.b1.text: And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?

matthew.15.p2.b2.text: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’

matthew.15.p2.b3.text: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’ he need not honor his father or mother with it.

matthew.15.p2.b4.text: Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.

matthew.15.p3.b1.text: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:

matthew.15.p3.b2.text: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.

matthew.15.p3.b3.text: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’”

matthew.15.p4.b1.text: Jesus called the crowd to Him and said,

matthew.15.p4.b3.text: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”

matthew.15.p4.b4.text: Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?

matthew.15.p5.b1.text: Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.

matthew.15.p5.b2.text: Disregard them! They are blind guides.

matthew.15.p5.b3.text: If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.

matthew.15.p6.b3.text: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.

matthew.15.p6.b4.text: but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.

matthew.15.p7.b1.text: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon.

matthew.15.p7.b2.text: And a Canaanite woman from that region came to Him, crying out,

matthew.15.p7.b3.text: Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me!

matthew.15.p7.b4.text: My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.

matthew.15.p8.b1.text: But Jesus did not answer a word.

matthew.15.p8.b2.text: Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.

matthew.15.p8.b3.text: I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

matthew.15.p9.b1.text: The woman came and knelt before Him.

matthew.15.p9.b3.text: It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.

matthew.15.p10.b1.text: Yes, Lord, … even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table.

matthew.15.p10.b2.text: O woman, … your faith is great!

matthew.15.p10.b3.text: Let it be done for you as you desire.

matthew.15.p10.b4.text: And her daughter was healed from that very hour.

matthew.15.p11.b1.text: Moving on from there, Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee. Then He went up on a mountain and sat down.

matthew.15.p11.b2.text: Large crowds came to Him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute, and many others, and laid them at His feet,

matthew.15.p11.b3.text: The crowd was amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled restored, the lame walking, and the blind seeing.

matthew.15.p11.b4.text: And they glorified the God of Israel.

matthew.15.p12.b1.text: Then Jesus called His disciples to Him

matthew.15.p12.b2.text: I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may faint along the way.

matthew.15.p12.b3.text: Where in this desolate place could we find enough bread to feed such a large crowd?

matthew.15.p12.b4.text: How many loaves do you have?

matthew.15.p12.b5.text: Seven, … and a few small fish.

matthew.15.p13.b1.text: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground.

matthew.15.p13.b2.text: Taking the seven loaves and the fish, He gave thanks and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.

matthew.15.p13.b3.text: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

matthew.15.p14.b1.text: A total of four thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children.

matthew.15.p14.b2.text: After Jesus had dismissed the crowds, He got into the boat and went to the region of Magadan.
